description: `notify.py:832-838`'s `send` runs `redact_text` on `project`/`title`/`message`/`dedup_key` before any disk write or push — a credential-shaped title or message must never reach `notify-outbox.jsonl`, `notify-state.json`, or (once a topic exists) the ntfy payload. No topic file exists here, so `ntfy_push` short-circuits before any network call (same no-topic path as `notify-no-topic-queues-and-flush`), and the record is queued with exit 0. `--flush` replays the already-redacted record off disk, so its own stdout line is redacted too — the CLI-visible proof that redaction ran before the write, since the fleet state/runtime dir itself is outside this harness's `expect_tree` roots (see `mv-state::notify`'s own unit test for the direct on-disk assertion).

expect.stderr: notify: ntfy unreachable, queued to outbox
notify: ntfy unreachable, queued to outbox
